rows.rationale: EEA registration obligation is codified in Norwegian Immigration Regulations § 19-2 and directly implements EEA Agreement Annex V. Highly certain — no recent legislative changes.
Primary source: UDI official guidance at udi.no/en. Cross-verified with Lovdata legislation. Source is authoritative and up to date.
Process is clear but appointment availability varies significantly by police district. Some districts have 4-6 week wait times which can cause deadline compliance risk despite procedural clarity.
D-number obligation is grounded in Skatteforvaltningsloven. Requirement is unambiguous for non-resident workers.
Evidence requirements are clear: passport + police registration certificate + employment contract. Application process is standardised at Skatteetaten offices.
D-number issuance is a ministerial function with low discretionary rejection rate. Processing times are predictable at 1-2 weeks.
Tax card obligation is an absolute legal requirement under Skattebetalingsloven § 5-4. 50% withholding in absence is statutory — no ambiguity.
Online application process at skatteetaten.no is fully digitalised. Employer receives tax card automatically. Process is streamlined and well-documented in English.
Tax card issuance is automatic upon D-number verification. No authority discretion involved. Outcome is fully predictable if D-number is in place.
Folkeregisteret registration for stays >6 months is mandatory under Folkeregisterloven § 2-1. Threshold is 6 months within a 12-month period.
Process requires in-person visit to Skatteetaten with multiple documents. Appointment availability can be limited. Process less digitalised than D-number application.
